description.value:
Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of those dice to pull off a trick shot instead. The save DC for these is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Dexterity modifier.

Blinding Shot. The target attempts a Constitution save or is blinded until the end of your next turn.

Brutal Shot. The target attempts a Strength save or is knocked prone.

Hampering Shot. The target attempts a Dexterity save. On a failure, it gains one level of slowed and has disadvantage on Dexterity saves until the end of its next turn.
